implementation.sharedCore: A directory-bound physical reader; original manifest wrapper keeps its original error code, leaf-absence contract and defaults
implementation.measurementScope: actualReadBytes/rawReads/opens cover only the selected head or segment during the armed formal probe window, excluding setup and initial reopen authentication; other witness files retain their own independently bounded reads
implementation.birthtime: Original artifactPhysicalIdentity Number/WSL1 birthtime semantics retained, not all-time-nanosecond precision
implementation.bounds: min(per-file maximumBytes, remaining maximumHistoryBytes), including remaining 0/1 failure before content reads
implementation.preparation: Full-precision regular single-link/size preflight, original ensurePrivateFile, then formal stable read metadata. Preparation checks path dev/ino/birthtime continuity; legitimate mode/ctime normalization may occur before the formal window
implementation.directories: One original root reader and at most one segment-directory reader per witness instance; no per-digest reader cache. Constructor can secure existing directories; first required existing segment directory may be captured read-only, first publish may create it inside existing CAS lock, bound disappearance/copy/junction never re-adopted
implementation.posixDirectoryMode: 0700 required during reads; broad permissions fail without repair. Windows retains original private-storage helper/identity semantics, not a new ACL authority guarantee
implementation.absence: Only the first head leaf lstat ENOENT yields old signed absent state, even after prior presence. Missing root/bound segments, referenced missing leaf, EACCES and dangling leaf never become empty
implementation.returnedStore: Recheck root/bound segments after byte reads and after successful signature/trust-epoch validation, including signing an absent store, before readStore returns
implementation.preserved: Schema/signatures/CAS/ancestry/discard semantics, per-read segment hash, trust epoch retries and revocation, 1024-record/16-MiB encoding cache and 16-MiB segment cache unchanged

remainingBoundaries: Sequential samples are not an atomic snapshot, general ABA defense, whole write transaction protection or persistent mutable-leaf inode/highwater pin
Stable same-byte new leaf inodes may be read on a later call; independent new constructors can capture their own directory copies
ensurePrivateFile may normalize leaf permissions before the stable read window; constructors and first publication may create/secure directories, so these are not installation open-only readers
Raw writeBytes, r+ fsync/confirmDurable and post-read proof signing retain separate old mutation/durability scope; no all-path bounded-write or full-transaction identity claim

RRSI integration covers actual source/v2 witness directory clones; segmented-witness I/O controls use genuine local test-signed legacy-to-segmented witness fixtures, not a claimed segmented RRSI production run
Synthetic BigInt and mode faults are explicit stat projections, not native NTFS same-Number inode replacement evidence
Native WSL1 EACCES rename results apply to the tested mount/runtime and do not prove ending checks or universal POSIX/Windows behavior
No complete journal/retention/authority storage graph, independent installation endorsement, protected durable routing pin/highwater, producer provenance or forced business admission
No real paid A/B/C, statistical quality PASS, production promotion, full Linux Vitest/macOS or release matrix executed
